## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added for new behaviour, or a regression test for a bug fix
      ([Testing Policy](../CONTRIBUTING.md#testing-policy))
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] Public API changes are documented
- [ ] Changes to selected quotes, page file names or URLs are called out
      as breaking
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Every commit is signed off under the
      [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin) (`git commit -s`)
